targets.review_note: For a rooted component, track the total downward movement work H and the minimum unmatched work L that must be paired with movement outside that component. Possible unmatched amounts have parity H and range from L to H. A child contributes [L_child+piece_count, H_child+piece_count] because every piece must cross its parent edge. Pair work between child branches; the residual minimum is max(H mod2, max_i(L_i+H_i)-H), where L_i,H_i include that edge work. This explicitly permits pairs meeting at internal branching vertices, which the rejected whole-branch-sum candidate missed. Reroot directed component messages to test all gathering roots; L=0 means all distance work can be paired, achieving H/2 operations. Preserve the failing first candidate and independent configuration-BFS counterexample.

targets.review_note: Build subtrees in increasing required size. Initially every size1 vertex is an available leaf tree. To create a vertex of size c, choose at least two available components whose sizes sum to c-1, replace them by the new component of size c, and continue. Enumerating component multiplicities, not labeled subsets, avoids duplicate branches; memoize the sorted forest and next internal vertex. Every valid tree admits this construction order, and each completed merge is a valid subtree, so the existence search is both necessary and sufficient for n<=24.
